card.name: Partway through rare drug names
card.fires_on: Middle pieces of rare or newly coined drug names such as oteseconazole, oritavancin, Rolvedon and theophylline, in drug-label text. It also fires on stray extra words split oddly inside a longer word.

modes.label: Inside rare drug names
modes.description: Middle piece of a long, uncommon drug name, usually after its first letters.

modes.label: Odd stray words
modes.description: A small word like these, the or some that wrongly sits before a noun, or a piece in spaced-out text.
